audit.why: 52.18% over 5479 games with the level chart Karma/Skill/Sion/Sion/Karma/Sion/Sion matches the written flow: she owns level 1 poke, Sion owns 3-5 and everything past first item. Mirror (karma__sion) already agreed the chart, so no chart edits either layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike is described as the moment Karma gains 'Mantra-RQ'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Karma's R is explicit: 'Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.' Level 6 is a Mantra RANK-UP, not its arrival, and the level 1 spike text understates what she already has.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4], mid and early now say Mantra is live from level 1 and ranks up at 6, with the rank-1 cooldown of 40s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly credits the root to 'Mantra-RQ' and calls the teamfight shield 'RW'.
audit.why: Per Riot's text the root is Focused Resolve (W), and Mantra-W extends the root AND heals Karma; Mantra-Q is a delayed cataclysm (damage, no root); Mantra-E is the shield that radiates to nearby allies. Every reference was one slot off, so the player was told to dodge the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: RW = extended root + self-heal, RQ = delayed cataclysm damage, RE = spreading shield/speed. Focused Resolve is a flat 12s cooldown at every rank and 675 cast range, so its down window is the charge window for Sion's Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number anywhere for her lockdown.
audit.why: Focused Resolve does not scale down with rank — 12s flat — which makes 'fight after the tether' a concrete, countable window rather than vague advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds mention despite Mantra-W healing her.
audit.why: Brief's missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup; Riot's W text confirms Mantra Bonus heals Karma, so chip-damage trades are undone without anti-heal.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into whys[4] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags 'Her Focused Resolve' as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive — Focused Resolve is the real name of Karma's W in the kit file. No name change made.

edits.before: Karma's Mantra-RQ delivers a root that locks you in place for her full poke pattern — her biggest spike, respect it and hold W.
edits.after: Mantra ranks up here: RW extends her Focused Resolve root and heals her through your chip — her real spike, so dodge the tether, not the Q.

edits.before: Mantra-RQ delivers a dramatically longer root that chains into full Q poke — respect her biggest spike, hold W to absorb the burst and avoid standing in root angles.
edits.after: Mantra ranks up here: RW extends the Focused Resolve root and heals her, RQ is a delayed cataclysm — dodge the tether, hold W for the blast, and buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.after: Root you with Mantra-W and chain Q poke while you stand still

edits.before: Once you have your full basic kit, your charged Q threat is genuine: Karma has no dash, so a landed stun at levels 3-5 means a free E armor-shred follow-up and real damage. Bait her Focused Resolve tether first — she will try to tether you to lock down the Q charge; dodge it by moving perpendicular, then start the charge. At level 6 Karma's Mantra-RQ delivers a much longer root and her W tether becomes a damage-over-time threat on top of the lock; this is her clearest spike, so hold your W-shield and avoid standing in an RQ angle when her Mantra is up. Ping your jungler if Karma pushes — her E gives her a speed burst that makes her hard to gank without setup.
edits.after: Once you have your full basic kit, your charged Q threat is genuine: Karma has no dash, so a landed stun at levels 3-5 means a free E armor-shred follow-up and real damage. Bait her Focused Resolve tether first — it is a flat 12s cooldown, so the moment it is down you have a free charge window; dodge it by moving perpendicular, then charge. Mantra is live from level 1 and ranks up at 6: RW extends the root and heals her, RQ drops a delayed cataclysm, so early Grievous Wounds blunts her sustain. Hold W for whichever she commits and stay out of tether range while Mantra is up. Ping your jungler if Karma pushes — Inspire gives a speed burst that makes her hard to gank without setup.

edits.before: Past first item Karma simply cannot kill you — your HP pool and W-shield absorb her burst, and your zombie passive means she cannot rotate away from a deep push without losing the tower. Force long side-lane shoves: Karma's Q poke is powerful but her kill threat on a full Sion is basically zero, so she is stuck poking from range while you teleport a chunk of the map. In teamfights her RW shield and RE speed make her strong utility, but your R engages over any distance and she has no way to peel you off a back-line target once you connect. Track her Mantra stacks — if she burns Mantra on a shield or heal rather than RQ, that is your cue to walk onto her with a charged Q.
edits.after: Past first item Karma simply cannot kill you — your HP pool and W-shield absorb her burst, and your zombie passive means she cannot rotate away from a deep push without losing the tower. Force long side-lane shoves: Karma's Q poke is powerful but her kill threat on a full Sion is basically zero, so she is stuck poking from range while you teleport a chunk of the map. In teamfights Mantra-E spreads a shield and move speed to her team, but your R travels 7500 units and she has no way to peel you off a back-line target once you connect. Mantra is a 40s cooldown she shortens with every damaging spell — if she spends it on Inspire or the healing tether, walk onto her with a charged Q.

edits.before: At level 1 you have no W-shield and Karma's Q costs her almost nothing — she will walk up, Q-poke you, and step back behind the wave before you can begin charging. Accept it. Last-hit at Q range and do not start charging your Q in the open where she simply walks back. The moment you hit level 2 your W-shield changes the equation: pop it preemptively before she steps up to Q, soak the burst for free, and look for a charged Q angle through a minion gap or from brush. Her Focused Resolve tether at level 2 is her only real tool — sidestep it or break LoS quickly, because a completed root chains into a full Mantra-RQ spike that hurts badly.
edits.after: At level 1 you have no W-shield and Karma's Inner Flame reaches 950 units — she will walk up, Q-poke you, and step back behind the wave before you can begin charging. Accept it. Last-hit at Q range and do not start charging your Q in the open where she simply walks back. The moment you hit level 2 your W-shield changes the equation: pop it preemptively before she steps up to Q, soak the burst for free, and look for a charged Q angle through a minion gap or from brush. Her Focused Resolve tether is her only lockdown — sidestep it, because Mantra needs no skill point and is live from level 1, so a completed root buys her a free empowered follow-up.
